wrong_buffer_sequence.canonical_diagnosis: Buffer sequence did not follow the QIAprep P1 (resuspension) / P2 (alkaline SDS lysis) / N3 (neutralization and binding adjustment) order.
acceptable_variants: Lysis must follow the QIAprep P1/P2/N3 sequence.
The noncanonical buffer order prevented the QIAprep alkaline-lysis workflow.

citations.title: QIAGEN QIAprep Miniprep Handbook (December 2020)

overlysis_irreversible_plasmid_denaturat.canonical_diagnosis: P2 lysis exceeded 5 minutes, risking irreversible plasmid DNA denaturation and restriction-digest resistance.
acceptable_variants: Prolonged alkaline lysis can irreversibly denature the plasmid.
The lysate remained in P2 too long, compromising plasmid integrity rather than directly causing genomic-DNA shearing.

citations.title: QIAGEN QIAprep Miniprep Handbook (December 2020)
citations.tier_justification: Official handbook states that long alkaline exposure may irreversibly denature plasmid DNA; genomic-DNA shearing is instead associated with vigorous mixing.
